title: Strength for every body
headline: Strength for every body
caption:
Think Pilates is just for women? Let's clear that one up this Movember. 💪

Our November theme is strength for every body, and that really does mean everybody.

Reformer Pilates builds a strong back, steady hips and better posture. That helps whether you play rugby at the weekend, sit at a desk all day, or simply want to keep doing the things you love for years to come.

With Bonfire Night on Thursday and the darker evenings settling in, this is a good week to book something steady for yourself. Men, women, total beginners: you're all very welcome on the reformer, and if you'd rather start one to one, PT and 1-2-1 sessions are on offer too.

This week's Pilates classes in Clitheroe are ready to book through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
